Investor-owned utilities charge 23% more for electricity than public providers
items.blurb: Average home electricity price from 2020 to 2025: investor-owned utilities +34%, public utilities +19%, co-ops +19%, against +24% inflation. Investor-owned prices rose faster in 38 of 48 states.
